creators.name: Haotian Mao
creators.bio: Haotian Mao is first author of LIVE-GS (IEEE VR 2026, TVCG), written with Xubo Yang and colleagues at Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Nianchen Deng of Shanghai AI Lab.
creators.why: LIVE-GS lets a language model set the physics of a captured Gaussian-splat scene so it can be handled in VR.
creators.bio_zh: Haotian Mao 是 LIVE-GS（IEEE VR 2026，TVCG）的第一作者，合作者包括上海交通大学的 Xubo Yang 等人以及上海人工智能实验室的 Nianchen Deng。
creators.why_zh: LIVE-GS 让语言模型为采集得到的高斯泼溅场景设定物理属性，使人可以在 VR 中直接操作它。

works.title: LIVE-GS
works.description: LIVE-GS (Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Shanghai AI Lab; arXiv 2024-12-12, published at IEEE VR 2026 in TVCG) turns static Gaussian-splat scenes into physically interactive VR: GPT-4o estimates each object's physical properties from rendered views in about 10 seconds, after which a Quest 3 user can push, throw at, bend or break objects; in the teaser a doll swings, a mug shatters and a ball bounces off a hammer.
works.description_zh: LIVE-GS（上海交通大学与上海人工智能实验室；arXiv 2024-12-12，发表于 IEEE VR 2026 / TVCG）把静态的高斯泼溅场景变成可物理交互的 VR：GPT-4o 根据渲染视图在约 10 秒内估计每个物体的物理属性，之后 Quest 3 用户就能推、扔、弯折或打碎物体；在示例中，玩偶会摆动，杯子会碎裂，球打到锤子上会弹开。
works.idea_en: Lets a language model author the physics of a captured scene, so a real place can be made touchable and breakable in VR without a simulation expert tuning parameters.
works.idea_zh: 让语言模型为采集到的场景编写物理属性，无需模拟专家调参，就能让一个真实地点在 VR 中可触碰、可破坏。
works.method: Objects are segmented from a 3D Gaussian scene and GPT-4o infers parameters such as mass and elasticity from rendered images; elastic bodies are simulated with XPBD and rigid bodies with invisible proxy meshes, and Gaussian inpainting fills surfaces revealed when objects move; the system was compared with people experienced in physical simulation who tuned parameters by hand and rated in a usability study (SUS 88.6).
works.method_zh: 先从三维高斯场景中分割出物体，由 GPT-4o 根据渲染图像推断质量、弹性等参数；弹性体用 XPBD 模拟，刚体借助不可见的代理网格模拟，物体移动后露出的表面用高斯修补填充；系统与有物理模拟经验、手动调参的参与者进行了对比，并通过可用性研究评估（SUS 88.6）。
works.specs: ~10 s parameter estimation · 30 fps in the parameter study · Quest 3 + RTX 4080 SUPER

paper.title: LIVE-GS: LLM Powers Interactive VR Experience with Physics-Aware Gaussian Splatting
